messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — Apollo Health migration lab needs to be scheduled. Customer wants a hands-on migration + smoke test. They span PST, CET, IST. Risks: renewal conversation next quarter; want to show momentum.
Sunil (Solutions Eng): Got it. Two options I can run: Tue 9am PST / Tue 5pm CET (which is Wed 2:30am IST) OR Wed 8am PST / Wed 5pm CET. Which works for CS & AE?
Jorge (Account Exec): Tue 9am PST is rough for me — calendar conflict. Wed works better. Can we do Wed 8am PST / 5pm CET? Customer said they prefer late afternoon CET.
Priya (Enablement): I can lead the hands-on walkthrough on Wed. Can we ask them to complete prework: add token, upload a tiny model, and run example? I'll drop a short checklist.
Maya (CS): Love it. Can you paste the prework checklist here? Also need recording + slides. AE: Jorge, is there renewal signal we should mention in the invite to increase attendance?
Jorge (Account Exec): Not public, but we should invite both dev & infra leads. I'll add product & infra emails.
Priya (Enablement): Prework:
```
1) Create API key in console
2) Pull sample repo: github.com/redwood-inference/apollo-migration-demo
3) Run `redwood status` and paste output in thread
4) Create a short prompt set (2-3) they care about
```
Maya (CS): Perfect. Can CalendarBot create a poll with Wed/Thu options and include timezone converter? :crossed_fingers: 
CalendarBot: Poll created — https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234 — options: Wed 8am PST / Wed 5pm CET, Thu 9am PST / Thu 6pm CET. Voting closes in 48h.
Sunil (Solutions Eng): FYI I'll need an hour buffer for setup. Can we set session to 90min and enable screen-sharing + SSH access from customer?
Maya (CS): Noted. I'll make the invite 90m, request recording, and ask for SSH whitelisting. Jorge — I'll send a heads-up note to customer that we need 3 engineers in the session.
Jorge (Account Exec): Sending note now. Also flagging renewal ops: if session slips >2 weeks we escalate to CSM manager.
Maya (CS): Added. If poll picks Wed, Priya & Sunil to lead. If Thu, Sunil needs to swap with teammate Anya.
Priya (Enablement): I can do Thu too if needed. Either way I'll prepare slide deck + a 15-min demo script.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. I'll post final invite and prework checklist once poll closes. :thumbsup:
